standard.summary: 启用 VRAM 峰值动态管理：实时监控 GPU 显存使用情况，在接近 OOM 时自动触发显存释放或降级措施，防止训练崩溃。
standard.effect: 开启后每步监控 VRAM 使用率，峰值接近设定阈值时自动执行：micro batch 拆分（将当前步分为更小的子 batch）/ 临时卸载 / GC 触发等措施。
standard.whenToUse: 训练偶发 OOM 但平均显存充足时开启（如某些 batch 因高分辨率图偶发 OOM）。
standard.avoidWhen: 显存使用稳定时无需开启（每步都有额外监控开销）。系统性 OOM（每步都 OOM）需要从根本上降低分辨率或 batch size。

standard_en.summary: Enables dynamic management of the VRAM peak: it watches GPU memory use in real time and triggers a release or a downgrade automatically as OOM approaches, so training does not crash.
standard_en.effect: With this on, the VRAM utilisation is monitored every step, and when the peak nears the configured threshold it automatically applies micro-batch splitting (dividing the current step into smaller sub-batches), a temporary offload, a GC trigger, and similar measures.
standard_en.whenToUse: Turn it on when training OOMs occasionally while average VRAM is plentiful (some batches OOM because of a high-resolution image, for instance).
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not needed when VRAM use is steady (the monitoring costs something every step). Systemic OOM (every step) needs the resolution or batch size lowered at the root.

advanced.principle: peak_vram_target_gb 设置目标峰值；soft_limit_gb 是触发降级的阈值；reserved_gb 是预留给系统的显存。diagnostics 模式记录每步 VRAM 使用峰值到日志文件，用于找出 VRAM 瓶颈 batch。micro_batch 模式在 VRAM 接近上限时将 batch 拆分为更小单元序列执行（类似 gradient accumulation 但是在 OOM 保护触发时动态生效）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 实时 VRAM 监控（torch.cuda.memory_stats）有约 0.5ms/step 的额外开销；micro_batch 拆分会降低每步速度。

advanced_en.principle: peak_vram_target_gb sets the target peak; soft_limit_gb is the threshold that triggers degradation; reserved_gb is VRAM reserved for the system. diagnostics mode records each step's peak VRAM usage to a log file to identify VRAM-bottleneck batches. micro_batch mode splits the batch into a sequence of smaller units when VRAM nears the limit (like gradient accumulation but activated dynamically when OOM protection triggers).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Real-time VRAM monitoring (torch.cuda.memory_stats) adds about 0.5ms/step overhead; micro_batch splitting reduces per-step speed.
